prior_review_integrity.verification_method: Recomputed SHA-256 for every path in the prior final-review.json manifests against current workspace files.

root_cause_closure.finding: Three zero-work-budget tests expected base PDF text scans to proceed for free.
root_cause_closure.resolution: Tests now assert WorkBudgetExceeded before any page read or table-finder call; the production handler preserves a terminal PARSER_INCOMPLETE result with the budget reason.

root_cause_closure.finding: The layout bridge test double omitted the required groups field from the production layout contract.
root_cause_closure.resolution: The test stub now mirrors the complete production shape; no permissive product fallback was added.

root_cause_closure.finding: context_policy was present in the generated runtime catalog but absent from its maintained defaults source and compiler path.
root_cause_closure.resolution: reading_defaults.json is the source of truth and the catalog compiler carries the policy into the generated catalog; tests and compiler check verify parity.

root_cause_closure.finding: A running-furniture assertion treated an incidental three-block model payload as the correctness criterion.
root_cause_closure.resolution: The test checks exact parent, period, target facts, physical proof blocks, and absence of generic navigation from model input.

valid_handler_red.result: Valid source SHA reproduces lost budget diagnostic before the targeted handler fix.

scope_limit: This review covers the six scoped CI failures and their 218-test regression suite only. It does not approve model-response quality, RF adoption, or whole-project/A05 closure. The parser contract for budget exhaustion is explicit failure, not resumable partial parsing.
